title: Conditional List Feature
description: 'minecraft:conditional_list' places the first suitable feature within a collection. These conditional features will be evaluated in order.

conditional_features.title: Conditional Features
conditional_features.description: Array of features, and their associated conditions, for attempted placement. These features will be evaluated as ordered.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Condition for placing associated Feature. If omitted, always places.

early_out_scheme.title: Early Out Scheme
early_out_scheme.description: Denote whether placement should end on first successful placement ('placement_success'), first passed condition ('condition_success'), or evaluate all features ('none'). Defaults to 'none'.
